_help: Guide bubbles for the tutorial level (the kitchen, room 1 of the story). Each step waits for its 'done' event, then the next step shows. target: what to sparkle (a hotspot key). Events: clue_seen:<id>, lock_opened:<id>, item_picked:<id>, combined, level_complete.

steps.text: Good morning, Juliette. Mamie Céline left you one last treasure hunt. Tap things in the kitchen to take a closer look. Start with the letter on the kitchen island.
Mamie's market list: 3 lemons, 1 cheese, 7 peaches. Close the letter, tap the kitchen drawers and enter 3 1 7.
Something's inside. Tap the batteries to put them in your bag (at the bottom of the screen).
There's a flashlight on the counter. Tap it to pick it up too.
Let's combine them! In your bag, tap the flashlight, then tap the batteries. (You can also drag one onto the other.)
A working flashlight! It's too dark under the sink... Tap the flashlight in your bag, then tap under the sink.
You found a key! Pick it up.
Last step: tap the key in your bag, then tap the door to the hall. (Stuck any time? Mamie's notebook in the top corner gives hints.)
